message.reasoning_content:
The user wants me to classify the relationship between two yes/no questions extracted from speeches by the same actor at different times.

Question 1: "O Ministério da Saúde deve assumir a responsabilidade de financiar e disponibilizar o tratamento da retinopatia diabética no SUS?"
(Should the Ministry of Health take responsibility for financing and providing treatment for diabetic retinopathy in SUS?)

Question 2: "O Projeto de Lei nº 3.811, de 2019, que institui a Semana Nacional de Conscientização sobre a Cardiopatia Isquêmica, deve ser aprovado?"
(Should Bill No. 3,811, of 2019, which institutes the National Awareness Week on Ischemic Heart Disease, be approved?)

These are clearly different questions. One is about financing/providing treatment for diabetic retinopathy in SUS. The other is about approving a bill that creates an awareness week for ischemic heart disease. Different measures, different objects, different scopes. Even though both relate to health, they are distinct issues.

Relation: DIFFERENT.
